subject: Mobile Development
title: The Digital Divide on Mobile
description: A fast breakdown of The Digital Divide on Mobile for builders.

hook.text: Smartphones connect billions, but 2.6 billion people still have no internet at all.

buildup.text: Women in developing countries are 20% less likely to own a smartphone than men.

discovery.text: Language barriers matter too. Most apps and websites are in English or Chinese only.

twist.text: Even people with phones face 'data poverty' — they can afford the device but not the data.

climax.text: True mobile inclusion means affordable devices, data, and content in every language.

punchline.text: Owning a phone isn't the same as being online.

quiz.question: What is 'data poverty'?
options: Affording a phone but not data plans
